headline: OECD Advises Colombia to Extend Fiscal Adjustment Strategy Past 2030
summary: The OECD stated that Colombia's economic rescue bill is moving in the right direction but warned that high primary government spending necessitates fiscal adjustments beyond 2030.
why: The OECD provides economic research, policy guidance, and fiscal policy assessments for its 38 member countries.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: OECD recommendations highlight structural budget deficits and public spending constraints.
